what the app does today: D18 fixes only the counting unit (robbery-based, counted by offense). The definition of a carjacking was in code only (compile.ts, CARJACK_VEHICLES).
proposed behavior: A carjacking is a Robbery (offense code 120) in an incident that also has a property record of loss type 7 (stolen) whose property description is one of: 03 (automobile), 05 (bus), 24 (other motor vehicle), 28 (recreational vehicle) or 37 (truck). Carjacking offenses are counted by offense (each robbery of such an incident); carjacking incidents are counted by incident.
exact default or choices offered: Definition exactly as written above; no other offense code and no other vehicle code counts.
why: Jeff 2026-11-23 (card answer, through the coordinator): carjacking = Robbery (offense 120) in an incident with a property row of loss type 7 (stolen) and description 03, 05, 24, 28 or 37. Example: California 2023 = 1,481. Counting unit from D18.
